biblStruct.note: Includes an edition and German translation of Yefet b. Eli’s Judaeo-Arabic translation and commentary on Pss 2, 72, 89, 110, and 132 (the so-called “Royal Psalms”), based on a four-volume Ms. held in the Bibliothèque nationale, with variants noted from 6 additional Mss. MS: St. Petersburg, National Library of Russia, Evr. I 576 is quoted as Firkowitsch (II) 576. (Biblia Arabica)
